task: Turn a PDF with selectable text into an editable Word document
packaging_note: Uses the published pdf2docx 0.5.13 package and PyMuPDF for local conversion.

inputs.what: a PDF with selectable text, including text in tables

known_issues: Scans need OCR first. Complex layouts, fonts and page breaks may change. Artifex no longer actively maintains pdf2docx.
licence: pdf2docx MIT. PyMuPDF and MuPDF AGPL-3.0, with matching source archives in /usr/share/doc/pymupdf.
